Hamari Kahani

Lahore mein Afghani zaiqe ki pehchan

Namak Restaurant — jise Namak Nomadic Cuisine bhi kaha jata hai — Lahore ke un pioneer restaurants mein se hai jo pichhle 15 saal se asal Afghani cuisine pesh kar rahe hain.

Yahan ka khana sadgi aur asal zaiqe par mabni hai: namak aur adrak se bani namkeen karahi, dum par paka gosht, aur khushboodar Kabuli Pulao — bilkul waisa jaisa Afghanistan ki riwayati dastarkhwan par milta hai.

  • Family dining — puray khandan ke liye pur-sukoon mahol
  • 100% Halal — Afghan, Barbecue, Middle Eastern aur Pakistani khane
  • Delivery aur takeout ki sahulat mojood hai

Services

Khana, jis andaaz mein aap chahen

Restaurant mein baith kar khayen, ghar mangwayen, ya raaste mein lete jayen — Namak har tarah se hazir hai.

Family Dining

Puray khandan ke saath baith kar Afghani dastarkhwan ka lutf uthayen — bade groups aur family dinners ke liye mozoon mahol.

Home Delivery

Garam aur taza khana ghar baithe mangwayen. Order ke liye WhatsApp par message karen ya call karen — baqi kaam hamara.

Takeout

Jaldi mein hain? Pehle se order karen aur aate hi apna khana le jayen — intezar kiye baghair.
